policy: Retain actual argv, cwd, timestamps, termination and exit codes. Bound each log below 64 KiB, strip ANSI and trailing display whitespace, retain one final newline, and redact credential-shaped tokens/assignments. Synthetic failure fixtures may be redacted too. Nonzero setup, intended red and regression commands remain FAIL. Never reclassify a nonzero command as EXPECTED_NEGATIVE.
